critique: The two frames convincingly reproduce the core Mapped Strings behavior: an edge-to-edge black field, animated looping particle paths, alternating dotted and continuous string segments, and dense turbulent clusters that shift substantially between t1 and t4. The remaining mismatch is primarily tonal and separation-related. The render is still overly bright mint/near-white at tight intersections, making the dense regions bloom together instead of retaining the reference's more controlled teal/cyan mapped appearance and clearer individual strands.

suggestions.why: Shift the flat particle color from pale mint toward a deeper cyan-teal, reducing the white/mint cast while retaining the intended luminous mapped-strings palette.
Lower particle opacity to reduce clipped-white knots at intersections and preserve separation between overlapping string paths.
